# Jantje's Warframe Tracker

> Sanitized, automatically refreshed Warframe account, build, and session context.

## Current context
- [ChatGPT-ready Markdown](https://drjantje.github.io/Warframe-Tracker/chatgpt-context.md)
- [Machine-readable JSON](https://drjantje.github.io/Warframe-Tracker/data/chatgpt-context.json)

## Deeper account data
- [Human dashboard](https://drjantje.github.io/Warframe-Tracker/account.html)
- [Account manifest](https://drjantje.github.io/Warframe-Tracker/data/account/manifest.json)
- [Session archive](https://drjantje.github.io/Warframe-Tracker/data/sessions/index.json)

The published data deliberately excludes raw account payloads and personal identifiers.
